scope: Original failed development commands and executed sources are retained in development.tar.gz. Successful exploratory builds are superseded by the final run, not failures.

failures.reason: The exploratory scalar-mode-off mutant changed local mode while its descriptor capacity was zero, so it refused the first one-valued case before the intended many-valued case. Retained the attempt. The final counterexample changes only d_many entry mode in a labelled WAT derivative, keeping the caller and other modules unchanged.

native: Fresh native R6/R6a applies and removes this exact backend proposal in a pristine disposable U1 copy; shared checkout contains only accepted R2 storage.
retention: Only unchanged bytes from reviewed prerequisite packs may be referenced by content hash; original failing artifacts remain retained.
prior_failures: The original conditions failures remain in immutable STAGE1-B-CONDITIONS-R1; this R2 does not duplicate that archive.
